The situation

A homeowner calls about a dripping kitchen tap and wants to arrange a plumber.

01 · ON THE CALL

A conversation that helps.

See how your AI booking assistant handles this enquiry.

Call recording coming laterFor now, follow the written example below.
WRITTEN EXAMPLE · FICTIONAL CALLER AND DETAILS
  1. AI booking assistant

    Thanks for calling. I’m the AI booking assistant. How can I help?

  2. Caller

    My kitchen tap is dripping. Can I get someone to have a look?

  3. AI booking assistant

    I can help with a visit request. Is there any active flooding, or is it a slow drip?

  4. Caller

    Just a slow drip. I’m Sam, at 24 Example Lane in Auckland.

  5. AI booking assistant

    Thanks, Sam. What day would suit you, and can the team text this number about the visit?

  6. Caller

    Thursday morning would be good. Yes, this number is fine.

  7. AI booking assistant

    I’ll send your request to the team with those details. They’ll confirm an available time by text.
